name: bwgan
text: bwgan is Welsh for goblin or bogey. MacKillop lists it as a Welsh supernatural being of fearful aspect, classed as a bogey or poltergeist. The short entry places bwgan alongside the related Welsh terms bwbach and bwci.

attributes.attribute: Welsh goblin or bogey, classed as a poltergeist-type spirit.

okr.objective: Document bwgan as a Welsh fear-spirit in MacKillop.
key_results: Classifies bwgan as a bogey or poltergeist figure.
